summary: Play, create and relax with the pixel coloring book & paint by number game.
description:
Have you ever thought about how hard sometimes achieving relaxation is? A tricky thing, and sometimes it is achievable in a very unusual way. Let’s take coloring for example. Yes, of course, coloring by hand with pencils can be more annoying than anything else because of how much mental concentration it requires. Don’t take us wrong, it can still be fun but not relaxing. While real things can be tiresome, we discovered that the mobile version of coloring is much closer to relaxation and even meditation. You just start this monotone tapping process, and you can be lost for hours.
We wanted to make something more than just a classic coloring app, which is why you will paint houses in our free game Pixel Art - Color House. It surely will bring you a whole other experience. Just imagine the whole house is yours, and all of the fashion decisions will be yours
So, let’s quickly look through the basics. How does number coloring work? You have a picture, and every color of it represents a number. Then you start tapping. Tap is how you color. Basically, that is it. And there are thousands of similar games without any differences. So, we thought that we needed to create something new for these games. That is why we decided that you will become a designer of houses! Instead of grinding and coloring picture after picture you will be creating on another level. You will be thinking about color patterns that you used and what matches better, how your house looks in general, maybe something is off. To make your painting process even more relaxing we added a music player. Now you can turn on and easily control calm music during coloring. This feature will help you to get lost in your thoughts or in the process even more.
Play game and listen to calm music to achieve full relaxation
Become a designer, paint houses and every little detail in them from the scratch
Comfortable interface
Pictures are part of the houses you paint
Use your vision to create the house of your dream
Share your pictures with friends
Create your own collection of tapped painting
You can play it offline
If you are looking for an easy way to relax, then play our free game with pixel coloring and you will find what you need. You can endlessly tap and listen to relaxing music while creating a house of your dreams.
